acceptanceCriteria: a release-gates.yml (or nightly) job runs make core-n1-replay against the documented N-1 baseline tags
a deliberately broken N-1 mode fails that job in a recorded run
the runbook step 8 text points at the job and the job's run is cited as evidence
body: Observed 2026-10-14 in the V1-0285 closeout lane (PR beamfall/corvint#901, branch claude/v1-0285-closeout-evidence, BASE 495eda08c). make core-n1-replay (Makefile:382-387) is opt-in and runs only when an operator follows the release runbook step 8. No .github/workflows job runs it, so the replay was red at BASE (cem/ocm N-1 modes broke after V1-1278 moved fixtures to cem/1.0) without any signal until the closeout lane ran it by hand. Expected: a scheduled or release-gates job runs the replay against the pinned N-1 tags and fails visibly. Actual: no CI coverage. Changes .github/, so AFP-V0-016 consent applies.
title: release-gates: core-n1-replay (CCF-V1-007) runs only from runbook step 8, not from any CI workflow
